target.title: fix(grep): stop searches when canceled during tool startup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who cancel a session grep while OpenClaw is still resolving `rg` could still have `ripgrep` start after the abort signal was already set.

## Why This Change Was Made

The grep session tool already checks for cancellation before resolving `rg`; this adds the matching owner-local check after `ensureTool("rg", true)` returns and before the child process is spawned. The sibling find session tool already enforces the same abort-before-spawn invariant after resolving `fd`, so this keeps the session search tools aligned without changing tool arguments, provider policy, config, or public contracts.

## User Impact

Canceled grep tool calls now stop cleanly before launching a new search process when cancellation arrives during tool resolution.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: aborting while `ensureTool("rg")` is pending rejects with `Operation aborted` and does not call `spawn` for `ripgrep`.
- Current-head proof at `3be1b4522bd8bf46b6d26da281505e99bf295765`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sessions/tools/grep.stream-errors.test.ts` passed, 1 file / 4 tests.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
